checks.pass: code is non-empty and getJob(jobId).client is not the zero address
checks.recompute: eth_getCode(escrow) and escrow.getJob(jobId) at the head block
fetch the receipt bytes, parse as JSON, canonicalize per RFC 8785, keccak256 the UTF-8 bytes

checks.pass: receipt.jobId equals jobId, receipt.chainId equals 84532, receipt.client equals getJob(jobId).client
checks.recompute: read receipt fields jobId, client, chainId and settleTx

checks.pass: the log deliverableHash equals getJob(jobId).deliverableHash and the log provider equals getJob(jobId).provider
checks.recompute: find the JobSubmitted log for jobId after the fund transaction

checks.pass: USDC Transfer logs move value from the client, directly or through a deposit route, into the escrow; the amount equals getJob(jobId).amount
checks.recompute: read the fund transaction receipt: the JobCreated or JobFunded log for jobId and the USDC Transfer logs
checks.report: fund tx hash, each Transfer from/to/value, the job amount

checks.pass: the transaction sender equals getJob(jobId).evaluator; the log outcome and payoutBps equal the job's outcome and payoutBps
checks.recompute: find the Verdict log for jobId and read the sender of its transaction
checks.report: recovered address (tx sender) and expected address (job evaluator)

checks.pass: a Settled log exists after verdictAt plus the challenge window and its payoutBps equals getJob(jobId).payoutBps
checks.recompute: find the Settled log for jobId
checks.report: settle tx hash, block and payoutBps

checks.pass: the recovered address equals signature.signer and equals the key published at /.well-known/jwks.json
checks.recompute: remove the signature field from the proof, canonicalize per RFC 8785, keccak256, recover the EIP-191 signer over the raw 32-byte digest

digestRule: specDigest = sha256 over the exact bytes served at the spec URL, written as lowercase hex with a 0x prefix.

inputs.jobId: uint256 job id on the named escrow
inputs.receiptUrl: https://agentcoinhq.com/v1/notarize/{jobId} (JSON object; the receipt is its "receipt" field)

outOfScope: whether the notarized content is true
whether the notarized content is good, useful or lawful
the identity or reputation of the client or provider
the quality of any deliverable beyond its hash binding
scope: Whether the notarize receipt, the on-chain job and the settlement are bound to each other, as recomputable from public data.

mustInclude: recovered signer address and expected signer address
settlement flow values: fund tx hash, transfers, Settled tx hash
verdictFields.specDigestRule: specDigest equals the sha256 of the served spec bytes; a verdict that omits it or cites another digest does not conform to this spec
